title: Unhinged
tagline: Got hot takes? Willing to put your money where your mouth is? Come battle it out!
description:
Unhinged is a social gaming app where you put your money where your mouth is. Twitter is full of hot takes and contrarian views, but do you think you can debate the world, Jubilee style, or are you gonna chicken out?

The gameplay is very simple, you sign up and enter in a spicy view you hold near and dear along with a meme template and get to swiping, Tinder style! See a particularly egregious ragebait? Swipe down and battle it out in public with some money on the line. Be careful though, others are swiping on you too!

How do you win? Run out your opponent's clock or make them tap out. Do that, and the pool is yours. Or if you'd rather not be in the arena, bet on two gladiators on a prediction market from the sidelines!
how_its_made: Unhinged is possible because of the amazing technologies by Privy, Flow, CDP, and LayerZero! All pretty UX stuff happens on Base thanks to convenient tools by CDP. The powerful math stuff? Through expressive Cadence on Flow! LayerZero helps orchestrate this complexity, and Privy? Privy abstracts this away from the end user. Unhinged is the mullet personified! Business up front, party out back; or like us decentralization maxis have come to appreciate, Web2 up front, web3 out back!
